افتحلا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَحَلَا (iftaḥalā) /if.ta.ħa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اُفْتُحِلَا (uftuḥilā) /uf.tu.ħi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اِفْتَحِلَا (iftaḥilā) /if.ta.ħi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
